## FaultPlan.consume() method

Consult the plan for `operation`<!-- -->. If a fault is armed, a one-shot entry is consumed (removed) before returning; a persistent entry is left armed. Returns `undefined` when no fault is armed for `operation`<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
consume(operation: Operation): FaultMode | undefined;
```

## Remarks

This method only reports which [FaultMode](./test-helpers.faultmode.md) fired — it does not throw or construct an error itself, since only the consulting double knows which typed `vaultkeeper` error class fits the operation's semantics (e.g. a signing operation's "key absent" is a `SigningKeyNotFoundError`<!-- -->, while a plain secret read's is a `SecretNotFoundError`<!-- -->).
